description:
# Check: upstream wrap-ansi.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/wrap-ansi.test.ts

## Subject
Text wrapping with ANSI code preservation and style re-application across wrapped lines.

## Upstream test count (approx)
20

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- does not apply underline style before the styled text
- no whitespace before underline reset code
- does not bleed underline to padding (ends with reset for underline only)
- preserves background color across wrapped lines without full reset
- resets underline but preserves background when wrapping underlined text inside background
- wraps plain text correctly
- ignores OSC 133 semantic markers in visible width
- ignores OSC sequences terminated with ST in visible width
- treats isolated regional indicators as width 2
- truncates trailing whitespace that exceeds width
- preserves color codes across wraps
- middle lines do not end with full reset
- re-emits OSC 8 open at the start of continuation lines
- closes OSC 8 before each line break
- does not emit OSC 8 sequences on lines outside the hyperlink

## Upstream dependencies
visibleWidth, wrapTextWithAnsi from ../src/utils.js

## Upstream notes
wrapTextWithAnsi(text, width) returns array of wrapped lines. ANSI codes re-applied at start of continuation lines. Full reset (\\x1b[0m) avoided for middle lines to prevent style bleeding. Underline (SGR 4) tracked separately to avoid affecting background colors. OSC 8 hyperlinks closed before line breaks and reopened on continuation. OSC 133 markers (semantic line tracking) ignored in width calculations. OSC ST = \\x1b\\ or \\x07.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/wrap-ansi.test.ts (15 assertions across 4 describes)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs (20 tests across 6 describes)

## MAPPED — all 15 upstream behaviors covered

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| does not apply underline style before the styled text | "does not apply underline style before the styled text" |
| does not have whitespace before underline reset code | "does not have whitespace before underline reset code" |
| does not bleed underline to padding (middle lines end with underline-off) | "does not bleed underline to padding — middle lines end with underline-off, not full reset" |
| preserves background color across wrapped lines without full reset | "preserves background color across wrapped lines without full reset" |
| resets underline but preserves background when wrapping underlined text inside background | "resets underline but preserves background when wrapping underlined text inside background" |
| wraps plain text correctly | "wraps plain text correctly" |
| ignores OSC 133 semantic markers in visible width | "ignores OSC 133 semantic markers (BEL terminated)" |
| ignores OSC sequences terminated with ST in visible width | "ignores OSC sequences terminated with ST" |
| treats isolated regional indicators as width 2 | "treats isolated regional indicators as width 2" |
| truncates trailing whitespace that exceeds width | "truncates trailing whitespace that exceeds width" |
| preserves color codes across wraps | "preserves color codes across wraps" (includes middle-line no-full-reset check) |
| middle lines do not end with full reset (general) | covered implicitly by the underline/bg/color tests |
| re-emits OSC 8 open at the start of continuation lines | "re-emits OSC 8 open at start of continuation lines" |
| closes OSC 8 before each line break | "closes OSC 8 before each line break" |
| does not emit OSC 8 sequences on lines outside the hyperlink | "does not emit OSC 8 sequences on lines outside the hyperlink" |

## UNMAPPED

None.

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir adds: plain ASCII width, CSI SGR stripping, CJK width (日本=4), fullwidth forms (ＡＢ=4), short-text-one-line, embedded newlines, CJK grapheme wrap, long-word break (`"abcdefghij"` at width 4 → `["abcd","efgh","ij"]`). Strictly broader than upstream.

## Action

No compliance ticket required. Closing clean.
